name: mysearch
title: MySearch
description: Search your own folders with the local MySearch engine: documents, scanned PDFs, mail, images, audio and video, in English and German.
author: HeyitSaif

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: MySearch
commands.description: Search your indexed folders by keyword and meaning, with a preview of the matching passage.

commands.name: search-images
commands.title: Search Images
commands.subtitle: MySearch
commands.description: Find pictures and scanned pages in a thumbnail grid.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask MySearch
commands.subtitle: MySearch
commands.description: Ask a question and get an answer, with sources, from your folders. Needs Ask switched on in MySearch.

commands.name: sync-now
commands.title: Sync Now
commands.subtitle: MySearch
commands.description: Ask MySearch to check every folder for changes now.

commands.name: status
commands.title: MySearch Status
commands.subtitle: MySearch
commands.description: Indexing, queue and memory of the MySearch service in the menu bar.

preferences.name: dataDir
preferences.title: MySearch Data Folder
preferences.description: The folder that holds MySearch's config.json (port and access token). Leave empty for the default.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "This extension is private: do not publish it to npm or the Raycast Store." && exit 1
